title: An integer multiplicity triple defines a current
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U. Then there is T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n: an ℝ-linear functional on 𝒟^n(U) that is sequentially continuous for TestFormOnConverges) represented by R, i.e. T(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), where ξ(x)(α) = ⟨α, ξ(x)⟩ and Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn U n, R.Represents T
